product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Maple Channel Tufted Vegan Leather Storage Ottoman with a Soft-Close Hinge, 45.3"W, Black
product.description: Storage is made simple and convenient with this stylish channel-top ottoman. A solid wood frame and tapered legs provide a sturdy base, and a high-quality galvanized, soft-close hinge makes it easy to shut small items away but keep them within reach. Black faux leather upholstery matches any decor. 45.3"W x 18.9"D x 18.5"H; seat height: 18.5"H; seat depth: 18.9"D; leg height: 6.3"H Solid wood frame and legs, faux leather upholstery Store small items and help reduce clutter in your home with this ottoman. Made with a soft-close hinge for easy use. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
